title: Shared prototypes, sampled instance fields and explicit bounded realization

supportedProfile: Immutable instance sets reference one mesh prototype and store explicit stable IDs, transforms, linear-RGB color and selection
Declarative mesh-domain or literal-point sampling uses bounded scalar expressions and seed/ID-based random lanes
GPU batches share geometry while explicit realization creates owned mesh buffers with defined normal and attribute policies
excluded: Nested instances, arbitrary geometry sets, geometry-node graphs and Blender pick-instance semantics
Implicit realization, automatic domain conversion, topology correspondence across edited samples and general point-cloud assets
Textures, lighting, arbitrary shaders and universal bit-identical raster output across GPU drivers

upstream.role: Sharing prototype geometry separately from per-point transforms and selection. Texloom uses explicit named sets, declared field inputs and deterministic source IDs.

license.note: Pinned primary source and execution symbol inspected for conceptual scope. No implementation is copied or translated; later source adaptation requires a separate file-level license review.

upstream.role: Realization is an explicit conversion from references to owned mesh buffers, with selected/all policies and named attribute propagation. Texloom does not implement nested Blender instance hierarchies.

license.note: Pinned primary source and execution symbol inspected for conceptual scope. No implementation is copied or translated; later source adaptation requires a separate file-level license review.

inputs: Explicit prototype mesh, units, unsigned32 seed and mesh vertex/face/corner domain or literal identified points
Optional position, quaternion rotation, scale and linear-color component expressions; boolean selection expression
Dimensionless x/y/z/index/rand/rand1/rand2/rand3 locals with typed shared source time and parameters
At most16 operations and4096 elements in total; realization has explicit vertex/byte limits
outputs: Portable instance programs remain in the authored bundle; evaluated immutable sets contain no copied prototype geometry
Unselected records retain their IDs and field values; selected GPU instances share prototype buffers
Explicit realized meshes preserve transformed geometry and declared captured/promoted attributes while enforcing conflicts and budgets
Original declaration JSON and exact decoded component expression sources are archived with spans
coordinates: Source position fields are object-local in declared units; spatial batch transforms compose after per-instance transforms
Quaternion and scale fields produce ordinary affine transforms; reflection is handled explicitly by winding-aware consumers
Random lanes depend on seed, operation ID, stable source-element ID and channel, never on playback history or current time
Realization bounds are checked against the corresponding transformed prototype vertices
errorPolicy: Reject invalid references, mismatched units, duplicate IDs, unsupported domains, invalid quaternions and nonfinite values
Reject invalid color ranges, nonboolean selection and unbounded operation/element or realization budgets
Reject attribute naming conflicts during realization; no silently overwritten captures
Reject duplicate/nonfinite literal JSON, unsafe sidecars and authored provenance before publishing a bundle

verification.command: python -m unittest tests.instance_port_spec_test tests.instance_capture_test tests.instance_player_test -v; npm test
claims: The real TeX fixture places256 directional arrows at generated surface vertices using one authored prototype
Independent numeric tests derive sample positions, transforms, colors, seed lanes and selected IDs from the authored formulas
Same-browser reverse captures, mobile controls and selection restoration preserve exact state and source geometry
An independent reflected selected-only fixture compares native instancing with realized-mesh pixels and bounds
Feature-specific PortSpec registration leaves historical raster goldens unchanged
notEstablished: Full Blender instance graph or realization equivalence
Stable correspondence after mesh topology/source-domain edits
Unlimited instance counts or arbitrary asset and attribute schemas
